title: Old papers
translation: When I think about it calmly, I miss everything that's gone, and there's nothing I can do about it.

Late at night, when everyone's asleep, I pass the long hours tidying my things and tearing up papers I don't want to leave behind. And I come across some practice writing or a little doodle by someone who has died. Suddenly I'm right back in that moment.

Even with a letter from someone still alive, when it's so old that I can't remember what it was about or what year it was, it gets to me. And the things a person used every day are still here, the same as ever, feeling nothing. That's very sad.
original: {静|しづ}かに{思|おも}へば、よろづ{過|す}ぎにしかたの{恋|こひ}しさのみぞせむ{方|かた}なき。
{人|ひと}しづまりて{後|のち}、{永|なが}き{夜|よ}のすさびに、{何|なに}となき{具足|ぐそく}とりしたため、{残|のこ}し{置|お}かじと{思|おも}ふ{反古|ほうご}など{破|やぶ}りすつる{中|うち}に、なき{人|ひと}の、{手習|てなら}ひ、{絵|ゑ}かきすさびたる{見出|みい}でたるこそ、ただその{折|をり}の{心地|ここち}すれ。
このごろある{人|ひと}の{文|ふみ}だに、{久|ひさ}しくなりて、いかなるをり、いつの{年|とし}なりけむと{思|おも}ふは、あはれなるぞかし。
{手|て}なれし{具足|ぐそく}なども、{心|こころ}もなくてかはらず{久|ひさ}しき、いとかなし。
literal: When I think quietly, in everything it is only the longing for the past that I can do nothing about.

After people have gone quiet, as a pastime of the long night, while putting in order various odds and ends and tearing up and throwing away scrap papers I do not want to leave behind, finding the writing practice or idle drawing of someone who has died: that gives the feeling of exactly that time.
Even with letters from people living now, when time has passed and I wonder what occasion it was, what year it was, that is moving.
The things (someone) handled familiarly, too, lasting long unchanged without any heart: that is very sad.

notes.quote: 残し置かじと思ふ反古
notes.text: {反古|ほうご}: old papers (see section 22). He is clearing out what he does not want to leave behind after his own death, and finds what others left behind after theirs.

notes.quote: ただその折の心地すれ
notes.text: こそ … すれ: 'it feels just like that time'. The handwriting brings the moment back, not only the person.

notes.quote: 心もなくてかはらず久しき
notes.text: 心もなく: 'without a heart, without feeling'. The object does not know its owner is gone, and that is exactly what makes it sad.
